text:
Sam (Finance): Noticed a systematic pricing mismatch on INV-2428 for several Dedicated customers. Burst rate applied on invoice equals $0.65/token but the commit cohort for the experiment should have been billed at $0.45/token for Feb-March promo. Need quick triage — this affects reserved+burst customers.

Yara (Pricing): Which customers are in the cohort? This was the A/B promo launched 2026-02-10 to test lower burst pricing for churn reduction. We tagged accounts that opted-in: cohort_tag=lowburst_exp.

Ben (Billing): Pulled invoice lines for INV-2428 subset. Sample export: 
```
account,cohort_tag,reserved_hours,burst_units,burst_rate,burst_charge
alpha-ops,lowburst_exp,60000,15000,$0.65,$9750
beta-works,lowburst_exp,40000,8000,$0.65,$5200
gamma-inc,,70000,2000,$0.65,$1300
```

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2428 generated 2026-09-02. Total due queued: $118,475. A/B cohort: lowburst_exp should receive $0.20/token discount on bursts for 2026-02-10..2026-03-15.

Iris (Product): Oof. The experiment injected a pricing_override tag into account metadata but the meter-to-invoice join used the default pricing table after we rolled a billing microservice change on 2026-03-01. Likely the pricing override flag was dropped in the join. INF-1602 raised.

Sam (Finance): Estimated exposure: roughly $15k overcharged across 14 accounts this invoice cycle. We need to compute per-account deltas and issue retro credits or refunds depending on customer preference.

Yara (Pricing): We offered the promo as a contractual concession for participants. We must honor the lower rate retroactively. Can you generate the delta CSV, Ben? We'll need to attach to credit memos and customer comms.

Ben (Billing): Running a reconciliation job now to recompute burst_charge using $0.45 for accounts with lowburst_exp and original burst_units. I'll post the delta table as soon as it's done. Provisional workflow: 1) create credit memos CM-540xx for each affected account; 2) hold collection for those invoices; 3) notify customers.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-999: "pricing-experiment-overbill-reconcile" and linked INF-1602.

Iris (Product): Quick note: not all accounts in lowburst_exp had consistent tags due to a schema mismatch on 2026-02-25. Reconciliation should use the enrollment export from the experiments DB as authoritative. I'll attach that to BLG-999.

Sam (Finance): Approval: I authorize issuance of credits up to $20k total to remedy this error. For customers requesting cash refunds instead of credits, escalate to Director of Finance.

Yara (Pricing): I'll draft the customer note: apology + explanation of experiment error, promise of credit or refund choice, and an offer of 30 days free burst waiver as goodwill.

Ben (Billing): Recon posted: delta CSV sample: 
```
account,orig_burst_charge,correct_burst_charge,delta
alpha-ops,$9750,$6750,$3000
beta-works,$5200,$3600,$1600
... (total delta ~$15,400)
```

Ben (Billing): Created provisional credit memos CM-54001..CM-54014 totaling $15,400. Holding collection on affected invoices and queued credits for posting pending customer confirmations.

Sam (Finance): Action items: 1) Ben post credit memos and mark invoices as "on hold - pricing experiment adj"; 2) Yara send customer comms offering credit or refund; 3) Iris close INF-1602 and update metering->pricing join to include experiment tag. Target: credits issued within 3 business days.

billing-bot: BLG-999 updated with reconciliation artifacts and CM-540xx drafts.

Yara (Pricing): I'll start outreach now. Recommend a standard script: apology, statement of corrected charges, and instructions to request cash refund if preferred.

Sam (Finance): Good. Please paste final list of affected invoices here once credits are posted so we can reconcile ledger entries."
